# Statement of Work No. 3

**Under the Master Services Agreement dated 14 March 2025 between Fable & Finch Creative LLP ("Agency") and Ostler Outdoor Co. ("Client")**

## 1. Scope
Agency will deliver the Spring 2027 "Trail Ready" campaign: creative concept, one 30s video, six social cutdowns, and paid social management for eight weeks.

## 2. Deliverables & Milestones
| # | Deliverable                  | Due          |
|---|------------------------------|--------------|
| 1 | Concept routes (x2)          | 6 Nov 2026   |
| 2 | Final script & storyboard    | 27 Nov 2026  |
| 3 | Video master + cutdowns      | 29 Jan 2027  |
| 4 | Paid social flight           | Feb–Mar 2027 |

## 3. Fees and Payment
Fixed fee of $64,000, invoiced as: 30% on signature, 40% on milestone 2 acceptance, 30% on milestone 3 acceptance. Media spend is billed at cost plus 8% and invoiced monthly in arrears. Invoices are payable within 30 days.

## 4. Acceptance
Client has 5 business days to accept or reject each deliverable in writing. Silence is deemed acceptance. Each deliverable includes two rounds of revisions.

## 5. Changes
Any change to scope requires a written change order signed by both parties.

## 6. Precedence
This SOW is governed by the MSA. If they conflict, the MSA prevails except for Section 3 above.
